letters.title: Naa Potti... naa Ammalu... ❤️
letters.body:
Ee letter ela start cheyyalo chala sepu alochinchaa... endhukante ninnu gurinchi rayali ante oka rendu pages saripovu ani naaku telusu. Kani ee sari "I love you" ani cheppadam kosam kaadhu raa... **nuv naa life lo entha deep ga part ayyavo cheppadaniki** rastunna. 🥹❤️

Oka strange feeling untadhi kadha... manam chala rojulu oka person kosam wait chestham, aa person vachina tarvatha kuda "idhi nijamena?" ani konni sarlu nammalem. Naaku nee vishayam lo alane anipisthundi. Nuv naa life loki vachina tarvatha chala things change ayyayi. Nenu alochinche vidhanam, prema ni chuse vidhanam, okarini ardham chesukune vidhanam... anni konchem konchem ga maarayi. ❤️🩹

Nuv naaku ichindhi just love kaadhu raa.

**Nuv naaku oka feeling ichav.**

Nenu ekkadunna, em chestunna, entha busy ga unna... "ee person ki cheppali" ani automatic ga anipinche oka feeling. Happy ga unna first share cheyyali anipinche person. Badha lo unna matladali anipinche person. Kopam vachina kuda chivariki vachi matladali anipinche person. Adhi nuvve. 🫂❤️

Mana journey perfect ga ledhu.

Konni rojulu chala close ga unnam. Konni rojulu words kuda sarigga raaledu. Konni misunderstandings mana madhya distance create chesayi. Konni sarlu nenu ninnu ardham chesukokunda react ayya. Nuv kuda konni sarlu nannu hurt chesav.

Kani ippudu venakki tirigi chusthe... aa moments anni kuda mana story lo oka part laga anipisthunnayi.

Endhukante prati sari manam dooram ayina tarvatha... **malli okarikokaram daggariki vacham.**

Adhe mana madhya unna strongest thing anipisthundi naaku. ❤️

Potti... ninnu gurinchi naaku nachhedhi nee smile okkate kaadhu. Nee personality lo unna aa small small things anni naaku chala special.

Nuv kopam lo matladina vidhanam.

Nuv edusthu kuda "em ledhu" ani cheppe vidhanam.

Nuv happy ga unnappudu sudden ga childish aipoye way.

Nuv konchem care kosam indirect ga expect chese moments.

Nuv emaina serious ga cheppina madhyalo sudden ga funny ga matlade moments.

Nuv naatho comfortable ga unnapudu nee original self bayata ki vache way.

**Ivi anni kalipi naaku "nuv" ayyav.** 🥺❤️

Anduke nenu ninnu oka perfect person laga love cheyyanu.

**Nuv ela unnavo alaane love chestha.**

Nee good days ni kuda.

Nee bad days ni kuda.

Nee confidence ni kuda.

Nee insecurities ni kuda.

Nee happiness ni kuda.

Nee silence ni kuda.

Endhukante naaku kavalsindhi perfect version of you kaadhu raa...

**Naatho real ga unde nuvvu.** 🤍

Konni sarlu nenu future gurinchi alochistha.

Years tarvatha manam ela untamo...

Mana conversations ela untayo...

Mana fights entha silly ga untayo...

Okarini okaram inka entha irritate chesthamo...

Mana madhya ippudu unna ee cute memories ni appudu ela gurthu cheskuntamo...

Ivi alochinchinappudu naaku oka strange happiness vasthundi. 🥹

Endhukante future ante naaku ippudu oka date kaadhu.

**Future ante nee tho kalisi imagine cheyyagalige oka life.**

Nuv naatho unte life perfect ga untundani kaadhu.

Problems untayi.

Responsibilities untayi.

Bad days untayi.

Konni rojulu mana madhya godavalu kuda untayi.

Kani aa anni madhya...

"Mana iddaram unnām kada" ani cheppukune oka person undadam chaalu.

Adhe naaku kavali. 🫂❤️

Ammalu... nenu ninnu konni sarlu hurt chesina moments gurinchi alochinchinappudu nijanga regret avuthundi. Nenu intention tho eppudu ninnu badha pettalani anukoledu. Kani intention kanna impact important ani ippudu ardham ayyindi.

Anduke oka promise chesthunna.

Ninnu "perfect ga chusukunta" ani cinema dialogue la cheppadam kaadhu.

**Nuv badha lo unnappudu ninnu ardham chesukodaniki try chestha.**

Nuv kopam lo unnappudu immediate ga argue cheyyakunda mundhu vini ardham chesukunta.

Nenu tappu chesthe ego pakkana petti sorry cheptha.

Nuv tappu chesthe kuda ninnu odileyadam kaadhu, manam solve cheskundam ani cheptha.

Endhukante naaku gelavali ani kaadhu...

**mana iddaram gelavali.** ❤️🩹

Nuv oka roju naaku "nuv chala manchodivi" ani cheppav kada...

Nijam cheppali ante, nenu ala undataniki oka reason nuvvu kuda.

Endhukante okaru mana meeda genuine ga care chesthunappudu... manam kuda better person avvali anipisthundi.

Nuv naa life lo vachina tarvatha naaku aa feeling vachindi.

"Ee ammayi kosam nenu inka better ga undali."

Adi naaku nuv ichina biggest gifts lo okati. 🥺❤️

Inka oka secret cheppana?

Nuv naaku enni gifts ichina...

Enni photos pampina...

Enni cute messages pettina...

Enni "I love you" lu cheppina...

Naaku most valuable thing enti ante...

**Nuv nannu nee person ga choose chesav ane feeling.**

Ee world lo billions of people unnaru.

Kani vallandarilo...

Nee life lo oka place naaku ichav.

Adhi naaku chala pedda vishayam. 🥹🫀

Anduke nenu nee birthday ni just "Happy Birthday" ani cheppi complete cheyyalani anukoledu.

Nuv naa life lo oka universe create chesav kabatti...

Ee sari nenu kuda nee kosam oka chinna universe create cheyyali anukunna.

Aa universe lo planets untayi.

Memories untayi.

Puzzles untayi.

Konni surprises untayi.

Kani avi anni just decorations kaadhu.

**Prathi planet lo mana story lo oka chinna piece untadhi.**

Nuv okko planet unlock chesthu vellinappudu...

Maybe oka memory gurthu vasthadhi.

Maybe oka letter dorukuthadhi.

Maybe oka reason telusthadhi.

Maybe naa heart lo nenu eppudu cheppani oka feeling vinipisthadhi.

Endhukante ee universe lo center lo unna thing planet kaadhu...

**Nuvvu.** ❤️

Day by day nuv mundhuki velthunte...

Mana memories okkokati open avuthayi.

And finally...

Anni complete ayyaka...

Nuv oka vishayam realize avvali ani na korika.

**Ee motham journey lo nenu neeku gift ivvalani try cheyyaledhu.**

Nuv naa life loki vachina journey ni...

**nee mundhu malli oka sari chupinchalani try chesaa.** 🥹❤️

Naa Potti...

Nuv eppudaina doubt padithe...

"Nenu important aa?" ani...

Ee letter ni gurthu chesko.

Nuv important kaadhu raa...

**Nuv already naa life lo permanent memory aipoyav.**

Nuv tho unna moments anni calendar lo dates kaadhu.

Avi naa mind lo save ayina places.

Nuv navvina oka moment.

Nuv naatho first comfortable ga matladina moment.

Nuv nannu miss ayyanani cheppina moment.

Nuv kopam vachina moment.

Nuv bujjaginchina moment.

Nuv silent ga na pakkana unna moment.

Ivi anni naaku chinna chinna stars laga.

Oka roju mana whole story ni venakki chusthe...

**mana universe entha pedda ga create ayyindo appudu ardham avuthundi.** 🌌❤️

Nuv naa life loki vachinanduku thank you.

Nannu choose chesinanduku thank you.

Naa flaws tho kuda nannu accept cheyyadaniki try chesinanduku thank you.

Naa bad days lo kuda naatho undinanduku thank you.

Naa life lo nenu imagine cheyyani oka beautiful chapter ayinanduku thank you.

And most importantly...

**nannu "nee person" ani feel cheyinchinanduku thank you.** 🥺🫂

Naa Ammalu...

I don't know exactly what our future will look like.

Kani oka thing matram naaku telusu.

Mana story lo inka chala chapters migili unnayi.

Inka chala places ki vellali.

Inka chala memories create cheyyali.

Inka chala silly fights cheyyali.

Inka chala rojulu okarikokaram irritate cheyyali.

Inka chala birthdays celebrate cheyyali.

Inka chala photographs teesukovali.

Inka chala nights maatladukuntu gadapali.

And maybe...

Oka roju ee letters, ee memories, ee whole universe ni kalisi chusi...

"Mana love story entha crazy ga start ayyindho chudu" ani navvukovali. 🥹❤️

Appati varaku...

**Nuv naa Potti ga undu.
Nenu nee Pichodiga untanu.** 😭❤️

Nuv naa life lo vachina person kaadhu raa...

**Naa life story lo nenu continue cheyyalanukune person.** 🫀

I love you.

Simple ga cheppalante...

**Chala chala chala love you.** ❤️

Kani naa feeling ni words tho measure cheyyalenu.

So oka word tho cheptha...

**Forever.** ♾️❤️

Happy Birthday naa Potti... 🎂💗

Ee sari nee birthday ki nenu oka gift ivvatledu...

**Nee kosam oka universe motham dachipettanu.** 🌌❤️

Open cheyyi...

Explore cheyyi...

Prathi planet ni feel avvu...

Prathi memory ni gurthu techuko...

Last varaku vellaka...

Heart daggara aagu.

Endhukante...

**akkade naa biggest surprise untadhi.** 🥹❤️🩹

Naa Potti.
Naa Ammalu.
Naa Pichi.
Naa Bangaram.
Naa Jaan.
Naa Pellam garu. ❤️🧿

**Forever yours...
Nee Pichodu. ❤️♾️**

letters.title: Nuvve Naa Motham Story... ❤️♾️
letters.body:
Nuvvu naa life loki vachina roju
naa life maaraledu...
**naa life ki oka artham vachindhi.** ❤️

Ninnu chusina prathi sari
naa manasuki oka chinna prashna...
*"Ilaanti ammayini intha rojulu ela miss ayyanu?"* 🥺

Nuvvu naa pakkana unte
samayam aagipovali anipisthundi...
nuvvu dooramaithe
oka nimisham kuda yugam la anipisthundi. 🫂

Naa prema ante pedda pedda maatlu kaadhu...
**nuvvu navvithe naa manasu navvadam,
nuvvu edisthe naa kallallo neellu raavadam.**

Ee janma lo nenu em korukunnano
aaku teliyakapovachu...

Kaani ippudu okati matram telusu...

**Naa repu ela untundo teliyadhu,
kaani aa repulo nuvvu undali.** ❤️♾️

Nuvvu naa love story lo oka chapter kaadhu...

**Nuvve naa motham story.** 🫀
